title: Live Sync : Matching the version
content:
Hi,  
  
Regarding matching the versions of CLO and Unreal Engine,  
  
I would like to ask you one question.  
  
I am using CLO 2025.0.148 and UE 5.3.2.  
  
When importing the avatar and clothes from CLO, but I run into the error message saying "There is no Livesync connection.".  
  
Referring to the image below,

![23c2e36aa9fb42d4bafd1bd357b6557b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/ddb5af0e0fc54a94adc6ca1d6bdd055b/images/23c2e36aa9fb42d4bafd1bd357b6557b01.png)  
Do I have to use only the 2024.0.132 version of CLO if I am an UE 5.3.2 user?  
  
Thanks.


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi WD_3d, thank you for reporting this issue. It is a mistake on my end not specifying the end versions for LiveSync 1, as none of LiveSync 1 versions are compatible with CLO 2025.0 and Marvelous Designer 2025.0. I will update the documentation accordingly. If you are using CLO 2025.0.148, I highly recommend you to check out the newest version of LiveSync here: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/ddb5af0e0fc54a94adc6ca1d6bdd055b

Comment 2: That's a bummer. For some reason, I have to use Unreal Engine 5.3 or lower versions.Thanks for letting me know.Have a good day :)

Comment 3: That's right, versions 1.1.2 to 1.1.6 are marked as "2024.1.88 and higher", but the 2025 version is excluded.The UE 5.3.2 version must use LiveSync 1.0.0, or 1.0.1.CLO must use 2024.0.132 or 7.3.240 version.
content_description: This webpage aims to provide troubleshooting advice for users encountering Livesync connection errors between CLO 2025 and Unreal Engine 5.3.2 during the avatar and clothing import process.

title: Why Bother with 3D? Core Benefits for Students & Small Brands
content:

Thinking about integrating 3D into your fashion workflow but not sure where to start?

I just published a new Substack post all about that exact question:

In this post, I break down:  
✔️ Why 3D is worth your time (even on a small budget)

Whether you’re a student working on your portfolio or running a small brand trying to cut costs and get creative, this post is full of practical, realistic advice from someone who’s been through it.

Let me know what you think or tag someone who’s just starting their 3D journey. Let's make fashion more accessible, sustainable, and fun to create.

title: Meet the Winner: Creator's contest 2025 Vol.1 - Seifuku Decoded (2nd place, KSK)
content:
## _Hasn't the community been eagerly waiting for this interview? Check out the story and workflow of_[ _KSK (Keisuke Higashide)_](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/204405/collection/collections)_, another winner of the recent Marvelous Designer Creator's Content Vol1!_

![ecb74a86d81b47bf9afcaae7e849c4bd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/ecb74a86d81b47bf9afcaae7e849c4bdezgif-5f44da7b3696b3.png)

# **Artist Introduction: please tell us about yourself.**

Hello, I am Keisuke Higashide, I am a teacher at a design vocational school in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan (Sapporo Designer Academy). I mainly teach fashion courses and costume design courses in the 3DCG field. This time, I applied because I was interested in the theme of reconstructing Japanese uniforms. In the current trend of uniformity in ready-made clothing, I believe that by merging existing designs with futuristic designs, we can discover new possibilities for design.

# **We’d like to hear more about the art direction in your Creator’s contest 2025 Vol.1 Seifuku Decoded Contest. What was the visual style you were aiming for?**

Since the theme was "Uniform Evolution," I focused on creating visuals that blend futuristic designs with archival elements, while preserving the essence of Japan. The concept is a world where traditional streetscapes, as depicted in Japanese animation, merge seamlessly with technology. Inspired by the uniforms of the Self-Defense Forces, I incorporated mechanical innerwear with old Japanese military harnesses and B-3 jackets, intentionally integrating historical designs. Being based in Hokkaido, I also paid attention to color schemes that blend into snowy environments.

![ca121f7e2691448b9e637362d2afa6b6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/ca121f7e2691448b9e637362d2afa6b6MD.jpg)

# **Would you be able to give us a quick overview of the different tools you use in your pipeline with a focus on Marvelous Designer? Have you encountered any challenges and how have you overcome them?**

The avatar was created in Vroid Studio and converted to FBX in Unity. After completing the design in Marvelous Designer, poses were added in Mixamo, exported as OBJ, and fur details were expressed in Blender for rendering. The rendered image was then edited in Photoshop to blur the background and add snow effects.

![210241bc8aaf433f99966564b67fa2a9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/210241bc8aaf433f99966564b67fa2a9pose.jpg)![27410239df3540fcb613d1458174e20d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/27410239df3540fcb613d1458174e20dpose_2.jpg)

![3f3c5bf4a18547139587d8b2d01d13b6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/3f3c5bf4a18547139587d8b2d01d13b6blrnder.jpg)![cb0b489bfdce439b9564f2f87fb251d5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/cb0b489bfdce439b9564f2f87fb251d5blender_2.jpg)![5722343da9514ad49af67fb9b2bacb9b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/5722343da9514ad49af67fb9b2bacb9bphotoshop.jpg)

# **Are there any tips and tricks with Marvelous Designer that you can share with the community?**

Even without knowing the basic pattern prototypes, you can achieve a lot of expressions by modifying default T-shirts and pants. Additionally, depending on the physical properties of the fabric, textures, and materials, it's interesting to see that you can create expressions similar to hard surfaces.

![f699157b538c429081d755101e6a25e4](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/f699157b538c429081d755101e6a25e4pattern.jpg)![1f9096f57bc6448e8a22fd4efb3d1348](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/1f9096f57bc6448e8a22fd4efb3d1348pattern_2.jpg)

![bb8b7e78705341b5b8074a489c179a0c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/bb8b7e78705341b5b8074a489c179a0cezgif-5fb1a4070fd9e1.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/be9e1768705e45f59ea4c10f19162d11%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202025-05-15%20%E1%84%8B%E1%85%A9%E1%84%92%E1%85%AE%206.30.44.png)
